in_sanskrit.name: Baaodhav
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of courage
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Baaodhav एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Baaodhav is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Baao' meaning 'Lord' and 'Dhava' meaning 'Courage'. It is a revered name in Hindu mythology, associated with bravery and strength.
